subject: Post-demo recap & 30-day validation sketch for Lucent Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Grant Miller <grant@lucenthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & 30-day validation sketch for Lucent Health

Hi Grant —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our end and a proposed lightweight validation sprint so your data science and clinical teams can assess fit without a heavy ops lift.

What we covered in the demo
- Inference modes: low-latency hosted API vs. private deployment for PHI workloads
- Example throughput and latency for a 512-token clinical note workload
- Tools: token-level cost dashboard, prefix caching to reduce redundant token cost

Proposed 4-week validation sketch (what we can run together)
1) Week 0 (prep): exchange a minimal sample dataset (de-id + schema), agree on two evaluation prompts (extraction and summarization).
2) Week 1: baseline runs on a sandbox model; measure accuracy and latency on 100 examples.
3) Week 2: iterate prompt/workflow and test prefix caching + batch settings to meet latency SLO.
4) Week 3: run expanded 1k sample, capture cost/latency breakdown, produce evaluation report.
5) Week 4: review, prioritize next steps (pilot vs. integration).

Success criteria (proposed)
- Extraction F1 >= 0.85 on sample set OR clinically actionable summarization agreement >= 0.80 measured vs. clinician labels
- 95th percentile inference latency <= 250ms for single-request path (budgeted for hosted API)
- End-to-end cost projection that keeps per-patient processing under agreed threshold

Owners & asks
- Lucent: provide de-identified sample + point of contact in clinical team (Grant)
- Redwood: Jasmine (engagement lead) and Ben (solutions) will provision the sandbox, Monica (CS) will own success reporting
- Ask: Can you confirm the sample dataset availability and whether SOC2 evidence will be required before Week 1?

Attachments: lucent_poc_sketch.pdf (proposal sketch, 3 pages)

If that looks reasonable I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff next week and drop the sandbox credentials once we have the sample.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu

- Latency target of 250ms at 95th percentile sounds fine; can you confirm whether that assumes hosted or private? We’d prefer hosted to start if PHI is removed.

- SOC2 / questionnaire: please share whatever your legal needs; we can loop security (CC'd below in a follow-up) but we can start sandbox work without the completed questionnaire provided data is de-identified.

I’m attaching a short CSV schema example to speed up mapping: data_schema_example.csv (header + 10 sample rows). If you can drop the 250 records to the secure SFTP link we’ll ingest for Week 1 runs.
